purpose: P2c-0 golden results of the REAL Lab payout reporter against fake chain/beacon/signer services (HTTP and unix socket only). They prove "same behaviour before and after a refactor", not "same as the real chain and signer".

crossCheck.result: 15 of 16 scenarios identical (state digests, signer requests, key log lines); only s02_invariant_c_on differs: df78e6b has no invariant C and pays all five pending entries in one batch, P1 holds the ones ahead of the committed cursor (two batches 4+1) - the known P1 change

normalization: see labE2e/harness.test.ts header: ANSI and logger prefix removed; ISO timestamps, durations and the wall-clock scalars updatedAt/createdAt/gasWaitStartedAt/frozenAt become placeholders; generation names and manifest writtenAt dropped; nothing else is relaxed
determinism: recorded once, then compared 3 times on the P1 root and once on the P2 checkout: identical; the first comparison exposed freezeH.frozenAt (wall clock) which is now normalized
